text: I purchase my domain names from XXXX. I make annual renewal payments. Firstsource Advantage have been emailing me stating I owe them {$32.00}. I renew my annual payments directly with XXXX. I do not have a pass due balance and I have never authorized XXXX XXXX XXXXXXXX XXXX to have access to my Go Daddy account. I have never signed an agreement with XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX. I have never signed an agreement with Firstsource Advantage. I have called and asked them to stop emailing me, contacting me for payments. At this point I feel as if they are trying to extort money from me.
